summary: File-stream close/cleanup with an optional write-flush path. Returns -2 when the stream pointer is NULL. When the mode byte at this+0x5C equals 119 ('w') and FileReadLoop returns 0, runs ArithmeticComparison_55f0 twice to sync the remaining-buffer state between the handle fields (this+0x40 with this+0x4C, and this+0x40 with this+0x8), then always hands the stream to FileHandleDestructorWithModeCheck for final cleanup. Called from file-loader call sites across the vehicle/HDV loader and scene writer paths.

local_names.this: file stream object carrying mode byte, handle and buffer state
local_names.a2: unused in raw source (thiscall stub parameter)
local_names.this+0x4C: compressed data size / remaining-buffer count field
local_names.this+0x8: target buffer pointer; pSrc for the write-mode sync

operations.description: If this is NULL, return -2 immediately
Write-flush path is entered only when the mode byte at this+0x5C equals 119 ('w') AND FileReadLoop(this, 4) returns 0; any other mode bypasses the flush logic entirely
FileReadLoop(this, 4) flushes the remaining buffered data of the stream; a zero result gates the state-sync block

ArithmeticComparison_55f0 runs twice, once with (this+0x40, this+0x4C) and once with (this+0x40, this+0x8), syncing the remaining-byte state between the read handle and the two buffer fields in write mode
Always finishes by calling FileHandleDestructorWithModeCheck((LPVOID *)this) and returning its result; the destructor call target is absent from the packet callee list

unresolved: FileHandleDestructorWithModeCheck is called in the final return but its address is not present in the packet callees, so no evidence ref binds it; only its cleanup role is inferable
